DHAKA, Aug 27, 2022 (BSS) - Bangladesh is being affected by 'economic conditions elsewhere in the world' as the country is now facing soaring prices of energy and food following the Covid-19 pandemic and Russia-Ukraine war.

These have led to energy shortages and rising import bills that are, in some cases, straining the ability of the country of 160 million people to keep up with debt payments.
